detail.longDescription: New tutorial: setting up Frigate 0.18 in Home Assistant from scratch with the €40 Shelly camera. Covers MQTT, the new camera management UI, go2rtc compatibility mode, NAS recordings, and local face + license plate recognition. Plus the Shelly one-connection quirk that hangs the camera — and the fix. https:// youtu.be/fh928oYm74s # Frigate # HomeAssistant # Selfhosted # Privacy # SmartHomeJunkie
